scripts.dev:firefox: web-ext run --source-dir . --manifest-file manifest.firefox.json --ignore-files src/scripts/** scripts/** node_modules/**
scripts.dev: concurrently -n webpack,web-ext -c blue,green "npm run watch" "npm run dev:firefox"
scripts.dev:firefox-dist: npm run build && npm run stage:firefox && concurrently -n webpack,restage,web-ext -c blue,yellow,green "npm run watch" "nodemon --watch dist/scripts --watch src/markup --watch src/styles --ext js,html,css --delay 1 --exec \"npm run stage:firefox\"" "web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox '/mnt/c/Program Files/Mozilla Firefox/firefox.exe'"
scripts.release:chrome: npm run build && npm run pack:chrome
scripts.release:firefox: npm run build && npm run pack:firefox
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run pack
